Small example of the Florida Pasture Cube shipped with the package

Source: R/dir.R
fpc_example_dir.Rd

Nine fields (three of each tier) with their composites for 2021-2023, optical and radar observations for 2022 and the labels of their counties, in the layout of the release. Use it to try the functions without downloading anything.

Usage

fpc_example_dir()

Value

Path to the example folder.

Examples

fpc_fields(dir = fpc_example_dir(), geometry = FALSE)
